source_tables.table_purpose: Main study schedule: screening, treatment cycles, end of treatment and post-treatment follow-up

property_hierarchy.property_comment: Top header band naming the study phases: Screening (up to 28 days before Day 1), Treatment Phase, End of Treatment (EOT), Post Treatment Follow-up Phase. Major study phases -> epoch. Label column is empty (the 'Evaluation' activity-column header spans all header rows), so the name is synthesised.

Second header band sub-dividing the phases: Cycle 1, Cycle 2 and Beyond (treatment cycles of 21 days per footnote a), Safety follow-up Period, Survival follow-up; empty under Screening and EOT. Mixes treatment cycles with follow-up sub-periods, so classified as period (sub-phases) rather than cycle. Name synthesised (label column empty).

Lowest header band giving the day of each column with its window: D-28 to D-15, D-14 to D-1, D1 (±1), D8 (± 1), D15 (±1), D1 (± 2), and relative follow-up days (30 (±7) days after last IMPs admin, At 60/At 90 (±7) days after last IMPs admin, Every 90 days (±7) after last safety follow-up). Protocol day values -> study_day. Name synthesised (label column empty).

source_tables.table_purpose: Per-sample PK and ADA timing (relative to start/end of infusion) for atezolizumab and isatuximab, with IMP infusion timing

property_hierarchy.property_comment: Study phase band: 'Treatment Phase' spans all cycle columns (2:21), 'Post-treatment' spans EOT and FUP (22:23). Major study phases -> epoch.

Treatment cycles: Cycle 1 (2:10), Cycle 2 (11:13), Cycle 3 (14:15), Cycle 4 (16:19), Subsequent Cycles (20:21); EOT (22) and FUP (90±7 days) (23) are cells vertically merged across this row and the Day row, recorded on this row only. Repeating oncology cycles -> cycle.

Day within the cycle: D1 (2:8), D15 (9:10) in Cycle 1; D1 for every later cycle. Columns 22-23 are covered by the vertically merged EOT / FUP cells from the Cycle row. Note the source prints the 72h and 168h (SOI of Day 8) columns under the Cycle 1 'D1' span. Day numbers -> study_day.

Atezolizumab relative nominal sampling times (SOI, EOI, EOI +30 min), referenced to atezolizumab start of infusion; '-' where no atezolizumab timepoint applies. Within-visit timing -> timepoint. Drug-specific: governs the atezolizumab PK/ADA rows. Parallel to row 6 (isatuximab scale); stacked levels 4 and 5 follow print order, not a parent-child relation.

Isatuximab relative nominal sampling times (SOI, EOI, EOI +4h, 72h, 168h (SOI of Day 8), EOI +1h), referenced to isatuximab start of infusion; '-' where no isatuximab timepoint applies. Within-visit timing -> timepoint. Drug-specific: governs the isatuximab PK/ADA rows. Parallel to row 4; this row carries the finest column split of the table.
Allowed sampling windows for the atezolizumab timepoints in row 4 ([-24h, SOI], ±5 min, ±10 min). Window qualifier of row 4; does not by itself distinguish columns -> level null.
Allowed sampling windows for the isatuximab timepoints in row 6 (±10 min, ±30 min, ±5 h, [-24h, SOI]). Window qualifier of row 6 -> level null.

review_items.call_made: Only the Schedule of Activities table on document pages 18-21 (the declared SoA range) was extracted. The 'Pharmacokinetics and Immunogenicity Flow Chart' (pages 22-23) and the 'Exploratory Biomarker Flow Chart' (page 24), which the SoA's PK / ADA / Tumor Biopsy rows point to, were not extracted.
review_items.alternative: Extract the two flow charts as additional tables (Table 02 PK/immunogenicity, Table 03 biomarkers), each typed 'subsidiary' because they give finer timing for the PK, ADA and biomarker activities of Table 01.

review_items.call_made: The merged text 'See Pharmacokinetics and immunogenicity Flow Chart' (PK, ADA rows) and 'See Biomarker Flow Chart' (Tumor Biopsy/Archival Tissue/Biomarker row) is kept as a cell value distributed across every data column 2-11 (source_range 2:11). The printed cell also runs into the Notes column, which is not a data column.
review_items.alternative: Treat each of these as a cross-reference (source_note annotation on the activity) and leave the grid cells of these three rows empty.

review_items.call_made: Header row 2 (Cycle 1 / Cycle 2 and Beyond / Safety follow-up Period / Survival follow-up) is typed 'period' because it mixes treatment cycles with follow-up sub-periods.
review_items.alternative: Type it 'cycle' (the treatment-phase entries are cycles) or 'other'.

review_items.call_made: Blood Typing Interference Test, Serology and Urinalysis (top of page 20) are placed under 'Laboratory Assessments' (indentation 1) across the page break; the bold rows Isatuximab Administration and Atezolizumab Administration and all page-21 rows are top level (indentation 0), not children of 'Disease Assessment'.
review_items.alternative: Treat the page-20 lab rows as top-level, and/or treat the rows after the Disease Assessment block as children of 'Disease Assessment'.

review_items.call_made: Footnote c ('evaluation not applicable for Cohort E') is printed in the Notes cell beside Isatuximab Administration but is bound to every cell carrying a printed superscript c (the D8 and D15 marks of 8 rows, 16 cells), not to the Isatuximab row alone.
review_items.alternative: Also bind footnote c to the Isatuximab Administration row as a whole (because its definition sits in that row's Notes cell), or restrict it to the Isatuximab Administration cells only.

review_items.call_made: Qualified entries in the 'Cycle 2 and Beyond D1' column - 'Cycle 2 Day 1 only' (Blood Typing) and 'X (Weeks 9, 18, 27, and then every 12 weeks)' / 'X (Weeks 6, 12, 18, 24, and then every 9 weeks)' (imaging, tumour markers) - are kept literally in that single column because the qualifiers name timings that are not separate columns of the table.
review_items.alternative: Normalise these to a bare 'X' and move the timing qualifier into a synthesised footnote on the cell.

review_items.call_made: The four drug-specific rows 'Sample RNT (h)' and 'Sample time window' (atezolizumab, isatuximab) are header rows (schedule properties): RNT rows as timepoint at levels 4 (atezolizumab) and 5 (isatuximab), window rows as window with no level.
review_items.alternative: Treat the two RNT rows as parallel scales at the same level (or as per-drug activity-level timing), since neither is the parent of the other.

review_items.call_made: Isatuximab infusion marks are placed in the columns their drawn cells cover: Cycle 1 D1 bar in columns 4-5, Cycle 2 bar in 12-13, Cycle 3 'X' in 15, Cycle 4 bar in 17-18, Subsequent Cycles 'X' in 21. In Cycles 2-4 and Subsequent these columns sit one column right of the isatuximab 'SOI' column.
review_items.alternative: Realign each isatuximab infusion mark to start at the isatuximab SOI column of its cycle (columns 2, 11, 14, 16, 20).

review_items.call_made: PK rows named with the full two-line label: 'Atezolizumab Sample ID' and 'Isatuximab Sample ID'.
review_items.alternative: Name them 'Atezolizumab' / 'Isatuximab' and treat 'Sample ID' as a caption saying the cells hold sample identifiers.

review_items.call_made: Header cells merged vertically over two header rows are recorded on the upper row only: Table 02 'EOT' and 'FUP (90±7 days)' on the Cycle row (Day row empty in columns 22-23); Table 03 'Screening' on the Study phase row (Cycle/visit row empty in column 4).
review_items.alternative: Repeat the vertically merged value on each covered header row.

review_items.call_made: The three label columns are turned into a hierarchy: each left-hand Sample Collection label (Peripheral Blood, Archival ..., Baseline or on treatment tumor biopsy core ...) becomes a mark-free level-0 grouping row, each 'Core n' a level-1 row, and the Biomarker Analysis text the activity that carries the marks (level 1, or level 2 under a Core). row_position is renumbered in reading order (header 1-3, body 4-19), so it is not the physical row. Notes-column cells bind to the mark-carrying analysis row.
review_items.alternative: Keep one activity per physical row (10 body rows) named by the Biomarker Analysis text only, carrying the Sample Collection and Core labels in cell_text or joined into the name (e.g. 'Core 1 CD38 and PD-L1 ...').

review_items.call_made: Table typed subsidiary: a finer per-cycle breakdown of the single main-SoA row 'Tumor Biopsy, Archival Tumor Tissue Collection, Biomarker Blood Draw - See Biomarker Flow Chart'.
review_items.alternative: Type it main_soa as an independent schedule with its own column set (its columns are not a strict refinement of the main SoA's columns: it adds Cycle 2, Cycle 3 and 'Cycle 5 and Beyond' and drops D8/D15).

review_items.call_made: The Notes cell beside the three biopsy-core rows is one rule-bounded cell with two paragraphs; it is one note ('Refer to I 02 for details. At least 1 tumor core is required ...') bound to all three core analysis rows.
review_items.alternative: Split into two notes: 'Refer to I 02 for details.' on Core 1 only and 'At least 1 tumor core is required, but 3 cores are optimal. Refer to Laboratory Manual for details.' on Core 2 (or on all three cores).
